question: Estimate how many college students in India would pay for LinkedIn Premium.
idealClarificationQuestions: Currently or at TAM (full addressable)? Both — give now and TAM.
Premium tiers: Career, Business, Sales? Career (most relevant for students).
Defined as paying out-of-pocket (not enterprise license)? Yes.
College students = currently enrolled in undergrad/postgrad/professional degree? Yes (~40M).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Frame the approach
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Funnel: total students → LinkedIn users in this segment → premium-aware → price-acceptance.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Of these, in placement-relevant final years (Engineering, MBA, BBA, CA, CS, top arts): ~40% = 4.4M.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Willing to pay ~₹1,500-1,800/month: ~3-5% (price is steep for students; most use free trials only): 3.5% = ~75K.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Today's reality: ~50-80K paying students in India.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Aware of LinkedIn Premium and aspirational

benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~3-5% (price is steep for students; most use free trials only): 3.5% = ~75K.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: TAM if pricing dropped to ~₹500/month student-tier

calculationFlow: Of these, in placement-relevant final years (Engineering, MBA, BBA, CA, CS, top arts): ~40% = 4.4M.
Aware of LinkedIn Premium and aspirational: ~50% = 2.2M.
Willing to pay ~₹1,500-1,800/month: ~3-5% (price is steep for students; most use free trials only): 3.5% = ~75K.
TAM if pricing dropped to ~₹500/month student-tier: could go to ~300-400K.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: Today's reality: ~50-80K paying students in India.
